textNodes.text: Mara designed it and then built half of it. We shipped two months early.
The brand looked like us from the first round. Customers ask who made our bags.
The rare designer who reads a pull request. Our docs finally feel fast.
She gave us one system our designers and engineers both trust.
Fast, calm and very, very good with detail.
